sub_problems.fills: A tools/base shim proof that starts a ground loop under a scratch HOME leaves no process of that scratch behind it, on a box with systemd-run or without it.
sub_problems.what: D1: _env pins CAIRN_HOME_HOST='not-this-box.invalid'; _kill_setsid_children reaps by HOME=<scratch> alone.
sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-12: akiendell (Windows) counted 56 cascade reds from orphaned web_server listener children left by a shim proof. Reproduced on akienasus with systemd-run off PATH and CAIRN_HOME_HOST unset. The shim spawned the scratch loop with setsid; the loop's web_server pulse logged 'systemd-ru
